origin.says: Built from 艸 (grass) and 日 (sun) with 屯 (sprout) as the sound: plants sprouting in the sun, spring. The grass and the sprout fused over time into the top part, so only 日 (sun) is still visible.
Simplified from 壇 (altar): 土 (earth) for the meaning plus 亶 as the sound; the complex 亶 was swapped for the simple 云 (cloud), which does not give the sound. It also replaces 罈 (jar).

架.def: frame, rack, stand; to prop up

origin.says: 加 (add) as the sound plus 木 (wood) for the meaning: a wooden prop or frame, 'rack, shelf'.

架.name: rack

origin.says: A picture of a bent object, perhaps a curved measure: bent, crooked; also a song. It also stands for 麯 (yeast), which it replaced.
木 (tree) for the meaning plus 直 (straight) as the sound: to set a tree upright in the ground, to plant; a plant.
日 (sun, day) for the meaning plus 乍 (suddenly; at first) as the sound: the day before, yesterday.
From 澤: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 睪 (spy) as the sound: a marsh; also sheen, grace. 睪 was replaced by the simpler 𠬤.
A picture of an upper garment: the collar at the top and the folded front panels below. It can be pulled apart to hold another part, as in 裹 (wrap).

衣.name: robe
衣.in: 装依裁袭袋裂滚衰壤裹哀衷镶嚷裳猿袁褒瓤

origin.says: 冫 (ice) for the meaning plus 令 (command) as the sound: cold as ice.

邀.def: to invite, to welcome; to intercept, to meet

origin.says: 辶 (walk) for the meaning plus 敫 (shining) as the sound: to go and meet someone, to invite, also to intercept.

邀.name: intercept

ety.hint: A house 宀 on fire 火

origin.says: 宀 (house) over 火 (fire): a burning house, disaster. It is an old variant of 災 (flood sign over fire), chosen as the simplified form.

卷.def: book, scroll, volume; curled up; to curl, to roll

origin.says: 龹 (two hands rolling rice into a ball) as the sound and partly the meaning, plus 㔾 (a kneeling, bent person): to bend, to roll up, a scroll. Simplified Chinese also uses it for 捲 (to roll up, with 扌 hand).

卷.name: scroll

敌.def: enemy, foe, rival; to match; to resist

origin.says: Traditional 敵: 啻 (only) as the sound plus 攵 (to strike) for the meaning: the one you fight, an enemy. The simplified form replaced 啻 with the simpler 舌 (tongue), which gives neither sound nor meaning.

敌.name: enemy

origin.says: ⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 贯 (string of coins) as the sound: what one does by heart, a habit. Simplified from 慣 by simplifying 貫 to 贯.
扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 氐 (base) as the sound: to push against with the hand, to resist; later also to reach and to offset a debt.

ety.hint: A wide 广 seat 坐; 坐 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 广 (building) for the meaning plus 坐 (sit) as sound and meaning: the thing one sits on, a seat, a stand or base.

询.def: to ask about, to inquire into; to consult

origin.says: Simplified from 詢: 言 (speech), shortened to 讠, for the meaning plus 旬 (ten days) as the sound: to ask, to inquire.

询.name: inquire

origin.says: 纟 (silk thread) for the meaning plus 录 (a form of 彔) as the sound: green, first the color of dyed silk. Simplified from 綠.

涉.def: sconcerned, involved; to experience; to wade through a stream

ety.hint: To wade 步 through a stream 氵

origin.says: 氵 (water) plus 步 (step): the oldest forms show two feet on either side of a stream, wading across; now also to be involved.

涉.name: wade

origin.says: 舟 (boat) for the meaning plus 㕣 (a small mouth-shaped sign, read yǎn) as the sound: a boat. In the modern shape the top of 㕣 looks like 几 (small table).

借.def: to borrow; to lend; excuse, pretext

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 昔 (former times) as the sound: to borrow or lend. The simplified form also stands for 藉 (pretext) in that sense.

借.name: borrow

ety.hint: A hand using a tool 攴 to strip the hide from a carcass

origin.says: A picture of a hand 又 (hand) peeling the hide off an animal; the pelt moved up-left and became abstract. It means skin, hide.

皮.name: skin
皮.in: 被破婆波彼玻颇疲坡披菠皱簸跛

ety.hint: To stop 至 under a roof 尸 (variant of 厂)

origin.says: Built from a sound part plus 室 (room) for the meaning: a house. The top changed into the unrelated 尸 (body), so the build no longer shows; sources disagree on the details.

彻.def: penetrating, pervasive; to penetrate, to pass through

origin.says: Simplified from 徹, first a hand (又, later 攵 'action') clearing away a pot (鬲), with 彳 (walking) added; the pot later warped into 育. The simplified form keeps 彳 and puts 切 (to cut) in place of the rest: to cut right through.

彻.name: cut through

贴.def: to stick, to paste; attached; allowance, subsidy

origin.says: From 貼: 貝 (shell, money) for the meaning plus 占 (divine) as the sound, first to pawn or pay extra, then to stick on. The simplified form writes 貝 in its cursive shape 贝.

贴.name: stick on

origin.says: 田 (field) and 土 (earth), which together look like 里 (village), for the meaning, plus 予 (give) as the sound: open country beyond the villages, wild.
亻 (person) for the meaning plus 圭 (jade tablet) as the sound: a fine, good-looking person, hence good.

ety.hint: Rain drops falling from a cloud 帀

origin.says: Raindrops falling from a line for the sky or cloud.

雨.name: rain
雨.in: 需露震零雪雷雾漏霉霸儒霍霜蕾懦霞雹雳霹霎霄擂蠕糯

origin.says: Simplified from 紐: 纟 (silk thread) for the meaning plus 丑 (clawed hand) as the sound, which may add 'grip': a knot or tie, a loop to hold; hence button, link.

盖.def: to cover, to hide, to protect

ety.hint: A dish 皿 with a lid 羊

origin.says: An old popular form of 蓋: 艹 (grass) plus 盍 (lid) as the sound, a thatch, a cover. In 盖 the top is now a 羊-like shape over 皿 (dish), a dish with its lid.

盖.name: lid

捕.def: to arrest, to catch, to seize

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 甫 (just now) as the sound: to catch, to seize, to arrest.

捕.name: catch

origin.says: Simplified from 橋: 木 (wood) for the meaning plus 乔 (tall) as the sound: a raised wooden crossing, a bridge.

烦.def: to bother, to trouble, to vex

origin.says: 火 (fire) plus 页 (head): a head burning with fever, so troubled and vexed. Another reading takes the left as a sound part. Simplified from 煩 by shortening 頁 to 页.

烦.name: annoyed

赚.def: to earn, to profit, to make money

origin.says: Simplified from 賺: 貝 (shell, money) became 贝. 贝 (money) for the meaning plus 兼 (both) as the sound: 'to earn, to make a profit'.

赚.name: earn

ety.hint: A foot 之 running into a wall or barrier 丿

origin.says: One reading: 正 (upright) with its top line slanted, the reverse of upright, so lacking, worn out. Another reading derives it from a different old sign. The meaning is to lack, to be tired.

ety.hint: To complete 纟 one's duties 责; 责 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: Simplified from 績: 糸 (thread) for the meaning plus 責 (duty) as the sound: to spin thread; the work done became 'achievement'. 糸 is written 纟 and 責 责.

毫.def: fine hair; measure of length; one-thousandth

origin.says: 高 (tall) with its bottom dropped, as the sound, plus 毛 (hair) for the meaning: a fine hair, hence a tiny amount.

毫.name: fine hair

origin.says: 言 (speech) for the meaning plus 寺 (temple) as the sound: poetry, a form of speech. Simplified from 詩, with 言 written 讠.

刺.def: to stab; to prick, to irritate; to prod

origin.says: 朿 (thorn) as the sound, which also helps the meaning, plus 刂 (knife): to stab, to prick.

刺.name: stab

origin.says: 日 (sun) for the meaning plus 音 (sound) as the sound: no sunlight, dark.

符.def: amulet, charm; mark, tag; to correspond to

origin.says: 𥫗 (bamboo) for the meaning plus 付 (hand over) as the sound: a bamboo tally split in two whose halves must match, hence 'tag, charm, to correspond'.

符.name: tally

顶.def: top, summit, peak; to carry on the head

origin.says: 丁 (nail) as the sound plus 页 (head) for the meaning: the top of the head, then any top or summit. Simplified from 頂, with 頁 (head) in its short form.

顶.name: top

夏.def: summer; the Xia or Hsia dynasty

origin.says: A person drawn as a big head (now the 頁-like top) and 夂 (feet), once under 日 (sun), later dropped: a man in the scorching sun, summer. The oracle-bone identification is uncertain.

夏.name: summer

抢.def: urgent, rushed; to rob, to plunder

origin.says: Simplified from 搶: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 倉 (granary) as the sound, now 仓: to grab, to rob, to rush.

抢.name: rob

origin.says: 雨 (rain, weather) for the meaning plus 辰 (clam hoe) as the sound: a thunderclap that shakes things, hence a quake.

漂.def: to drift, to float; to be tossed about; bleach

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 票 (ticket) as the sound: to float or drift on water; also to bleach by rinsing, and 'pretty' in 漂亮 (pretty).

漂.name: float

握.def: to grasp, to hold, to take by the hand

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 屋 (house) as the sound: to grasp, to hold in the hand.

握.name: hold tight

ety.hint: Two hands 八 holding an axe 丘

origin.says: 斤 (axe) above two hands (the bottom part, once 廾): hands holding a weapon, hence weapon, soldier, troops.
立 (stand) for the meaning plus 耑 (sprout, tip) as the sound: standing upright and straight; from the sprout's tip also 'end, extremity'.
白 (white) as the sound with 一 (one) on top to mark the number: one hundred.

洗.def: to bathe, to rinse, to wash

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 先 as the sound: to wash. Since 先 shows a foot, one reading says it first meant washing the feet.

洗.name: wash

胁.def: to threaten, to coerce; ribs, flank

origin.says: Simplified from 脅/脇: ⺼ (flesh) for the meaning plus 劦 (three 力) as the sound: the flank, the ribs; hence to threaten. The simplified form writes 劦 as 办.

胁.name: ribs threat

恢.def: to restore, to recover; great, immense, vast

origin.says: ⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 灰 (ash) as the sound: a broad, generous heart, hence vast; later 'to restore'.

恢.name: restore

ety.hint: Bamboo strips 冂 tied together to form a book

origin.says: A drawing of bamboo slips strung together with cord: an ancient book, hence volume and register.
艹 (plants) for the meaning plus 采 (pluck) as the sound and hint: plants that are picked to eat, vegetables, then dishes.

夜.def: night, dark; under cover of night

ety.hint: A person 亻 sneaking by under cover 亠 of night 夕

origin.says: 亦 (armpit, also) as the sound, shortened, plus 夕 (moon, evening) for the meaning: night. In the modern shape 亦 has broken into 亠 + 亻, its last stroke merged into 夕.

夜.name: night

ety.hint: To leave 辶 something valuable 贵 behind

origin.says: 辶 (walk) for the meaning plus 贵 (precious) as the sound: what is left behind on the way, to lose, to bequeath. Simplified from 遺 (貴 → 贵).

轮.def: wheel; to turn, to revolve; to recur

origin.says: Simplified from 輪: 車 (cart) for the meaning plus 侖 (order) as the sound: the wheel, spokes in order; now 车 and 仑.

轮.name: wheel

档.def: shelve, frame; files, records; grade, level

origin.says: 木 (wood) for the meaning plus 当 (serve as) as the sound: a wooden shelf or frame, then files kept on it and grades. Simplified from 檔 along with 当.

档.name: file

origin.says: 犭 (dog) for the meaning plus a sound part that was the old form of 往 (go), now written 王 (king): a mad dog, hence wild, crazy.

ety.hint: To walk 辶 quickly 卂; 卂 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 辶 (walking) for the meaning plus 卂 (to fly fast) as the sound and meaning: moving fast, swift.

朝.def: to face; direct, facing; dynasty; morning

origin.says: 日 (sun) among grass on the left, with 月 (moon) on the right: the sun rising while the moon is still up, early morning. Bronze forms had a river instead of the moon; the modern form returns to the moon.

朝.name: dawn

忆.def: to remember, to reflect upon; memory

origin.says: Simplified from 憶: ⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 意 (thought) as the sound, replaced by 乙 (second) as a simpler sound part: to remember.

忆.name: memory

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 胡 (reckless) as the sound: a lake.
The full form 龍 is a picture of a dragon: a big-mouthed, crested head on a long snake-like body. Simplified 龙 is based on a cursive form.

启.def: to open; to begin, to commence; to explain

ety.hint: A door 户 being opened 口

origin.says: Traditional 啓 is 户 (door) plus 攵 (hand) plus 口 (mouth): a hand opening a door, hence to open, to begin, to explain. The simplified form drops the hand, leaving door over mouth.

启.name: open door

废.def: to terminate; to discard; to abgrogate

origin.says: Simplified from 廢: 广 (house) for the meaning plus 發 (send out), now 发, as the sound: a collapsed house, hence abandoned, waste.

废.name: discard

赞.def: to help, to support; to laud, to praise

origin.says: Simplified from 贊: 兟 (two people pressing forward) as the sound plus 貝 (shell, money) for the meaning: helping with money, then to support and praise. 貝 became 贝.

赞.name: praise

origin.says: 马 (horse) for the meaning plus 主 (master) as the sound: a horse standing still, to halt, to be stationed. Simplified from 駐, with 馬 written 马.

罚.def: penalty, fine; to punish, to penalize

ety.hint: Simplified form of 罰; to punish 刂 the accused 詈

origin.says: Traditional 罰 is 詈 (to scold: 罒 net over 言 speech) plus 刂 (knife): a scolding or a cut as penalty for a crime. Simplified by writing 言 (speech) as 讠.

罚.name: punish

origin.says: 波 (wave) as the sound plus 女 (woman) for the meaning: an old woman, grandmother.

荐.def: to recommend; to recur, to repeat

ety.hint: A perennial; grass 艹 that survives 存 year-after-year

origin.says: The full form 薦 was 艹 (grass) + 廌 (a wild beast): pasture grass or a straw mat, borrowed for its sound to mean recommend. Simplified by taking over 荐, an old character for a grass mat, built from 艹 (grass) + 存 (keep) as the sound.

荐.name: recommend

幕.def: curtain, screen, tent; measure word for plays and shows

origin.says: 莫 (do not) as the sound plus 巾 (cloth) for the meaning: a curtain or tent cloth, and so an act of a play.

幕.name: stage curtain

origin.says: 乘 (ride) as the sound plus 刂 (knife) for the meaning: what is left over after cutting, the leftovers.

逃.def: to abscond, to dodge, to escape, to flee

origin.says: 辶 (walk) for the meaning plus 兆 (omen) as the sound: to run away, flee.

逃.name: flee

折.def: to break, to snap; to fold, to bend; to bow; humble

ety.hint: A hand 扌 wielding an axe 斤

origin.says: First a tree cut in two pieces beside 斤 (axe): to chop, to break. The split tree later took the shape of 扌 (hand), so it now reads as a hand with an axe.

折.name: snap

origin.says: From 靜: 爭 (strive, now 争) as the sound and 青 (blue-green), which one reading takes as a second sound part and another as the meaning 'clear, calm': still, quiet.

奋.def: to strive, to exert effort; to arouse

ety.hint: A man 大 working on the farm 田

origin.says: Simplified from 奮: a bird (隹) spreading its wings (大) over a field (田) to take off: to exert oneself. The simplified form drops 隹. Some sources call the origin unclear.

奋.name: take wing

ety.hint: Hemp plants 林 growing in a greenhouse 广

origin.says: 广 (shelter, originally 厂 cliff) over two 木 (tree) shapes that once showed hemp stalks with their fibres stripped: hemp drying under a roof. Later also 'numb'. The exact build is not fully clear.
纟 (silk) for the meaning plus 屯 as the sound: plain, unmixed silk, hence pure, simple, genuine. Simplified from 純.
